name: Clue Hunt
summary: A 404 page where your pointer is a magnifying glass hunting clues with a detective bird
about: A sepia case-file 404 page with Inspector Bulbul, a detective bird whose eyes and head follow your lens. The scene stays dark until the magnifying glass passes over it, revealing footprints, a big 404 and three hidden clues; find them all to close the case and follow the trail home. It also keeps the usual 404 tools: home, go back, search and popular links.
how: Move the mouse or drag a finger over the dark scene: the pointer becomes a springy magnifying glass
The lens reveals hidden ink: footprints, a big 404 and a note about where the page went
Hold the lens over a clue (or click it) to stamp it Found, with a burst and a hop from the inspector
The evidence list and meter tick off each clue, and the bird scribbles in its notebook
With all three found, red string links the clues to the house, confetti flies and the trail home opens
Keyboard: focus the scene, move with the arrow keys and press Enter; Show all clues reveals everything at once
